title: Sub-brands / Construction
slide_intent: Use a shared measure and a clear hierarchy because related names need to read together without competing equally.
strategic_value: A common x-height and counter-based gap can make Duolingo’s sub-brand signatures consistent.
demonstration: A construction diagram pairs the core wordmark and sub-brand title at shared x-height, separated by the o-counter width, with weight providing hierarchy.
practical_value: Check shared x-height, gap and weight contrast in a generic sub-brand signature.

content_islands.name: Hierarchy explanation
content_islands.spec: Place the heading, common x-height, counter-width gap and weight rationale in the right column.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source explains that weight supplies hierarchy because the elements have essentially the same size.

reference_purposes.Constraint: The source states those size and spacing relationships for the generic construction.

ingredient.role: Make master name and sub-brand read as a coherent hierarchy.
